key.name: stage-enabled
key.description: Opt in to Stage Manager after enabling the extension. Only the primary monitor and current workspace are managed; each window is a separate stage without multiwindow grouping.

key.name: strip-edge
key.description: The edge of the primary monitor used for window previews.

key.name: preview-width
key.description: Window preview width in logical pixels.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: Transition duration in milliseconds. Zero disables animation.

key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.description: GTK accelerators to toggle Stage Manager. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: next-shortcut
key.description: GTK accelerators to activate the next window. An empty array disables the shortcut.

key.name: previous-shortcut
key.description: GTK accelerators to activate the previous window. An empty array disables the shortcut.
